result.summary: WF-03 Step 1 diagnosis for GH-792/ISS-0707 confirmed (with corrections). Root cause: unqualified solution_pack_installs resolves via the per-tenant search_path to tenant_default.solution_pack_installs (migration 1158 SOL-02, different column layout) instead of the intended public.solution_pack_installs (migration 1157) -> sqlstate 42703 on all 4 TC-PRM-09 tests on fresh-migration DBs. Verified empirically that the current warm bpm_test :5453 masks the bug (legacy 1157-layout shadow; compiled test binary passes 4/4 today). SCOPE CORRECTION (MAJOR): the SUT src/definition/pack_update.zig also queries solution_pack_installs/artefact_bases unqualified (lines 117/179) and would 42703 on a fresh DB, so a test-code-only fix is insufficient; the fix must also qualify those two public-schema tables in pack_update.zig. process_definitions stays unqualified (tenant-side). Full fix spec in result.fix_spec. No fix implemented (Step 1 only).

issues.description: Documented 'test-code only' scope insufficient: src/definition/pack_update.zig (SUT) queries solution_pack_installs (L117) and solution_pack_artefact_bases (L179) unqualified; on a fresh-migration DB the SUT itself raises 42703, so a test-file-only fix would still fail all 4 tests. Fix must include pack_update.zig.
Issue-cited verification target 'test-integration-prm-09' does not exist; actual build.zig:3164 step is 'test-integration-prm09'.

ISS-0707 states migration 1157 is 'scope: tenant_only per the GH-785 fix'; actual 1157 header is '-- scope: public.' with public.-qualified DDL (GH-785 51170eed). The tenant_default shadow is migration 1158 (SOL-02).
ISS-0707 reproduction cites BPM_TEST_DB_URL port 5434; this workspace's test DB is :5453.

fix_spec.diagnosis: Unqualified solution_pack_installs resolves to the tenant_default shadow (migration 1158, SOL-02, tenant_only) under the per-tenant search_path 'tenant_default,public' (pool applyRequestStorageRouting, zero-UUID tenant + SCHEMA mode), instead of the PRM-09 intended public.solution_pack_installs (migration 1157, scope public). On a fresh migration replay the tenant_default shadow has the 1158 layout (id, pack_id, pack_version, schema_version, installed_by, installed_at) which lacks tenant_id/installed_version -> sqlstate 42703 on all 4 TC-PRM-09 tests. Warm bpm_test :5453 currently masks the bug (legacy 1157-layout shadow), so the test passes 4/4 locally today; the fix must still be applied for fresh/CI DBs.
test_occurrences_to_qualify: L119 SELECT id::text FROM solution_pack_installs   -> public.solution_pack_installs
L128 INSERT INTO solution_pack_artefact_bases      -> public.solution_pack_artefact_bases (defensive; no tenant shadow exists today but consistent with SUT)
test_references_to_leave_unqualified: L145 / L160 process_definitions (tenant-side table; test inserts and SUT reads both target tenant_default.process_definitions)
fix_spec.no_test_setup_depends_on_tenant_side_row: Verified: test fixtures insert the tenant into public.tenant (qualified) and pack-install rows into the PRM-09 table; the SOL-02 tenant_default.solution_pack_installs is a different feature's table and is not part of the PRM-09 fixture contract. Qualifying to public. preserves fixture semantics.
fix_spec.verification_command: BPM_TEST_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5453/bpm_test zig build test-integration-prm09 (4/4). Warm DB currently passes pre-fix due to masking; additionally validate on a fresh migration replay or assert the public. qualification statically.
fix_spec.scope: Test-code + exactly one production file (src/definition/pack_update.zig). No migrations, no other production files. This EXPANDS the documented 'test-code only' scope (see MAJOR issue).

result.next_action: Route to CODE-DESIGNER / BACKEND-DEV (WF-03 Steps 2-3) to implement the fix per result.fix_spec (qualify solution_pack_installs + solution_pack_artefact_bases with public. in the test file L98/119/164/128 AND in src/definition/pack_update.zig L117/179; leave process_definitions unqualified); verify test-integration-prm09 4/4.
